entrypoints.summary: An application invokes ObjectMapper.readValue on attacker-supplied JSON while UNWRAP_SINGLE_VALUE_ARRAYS is enabled.
The audit identifies BeanDeserializer exposure only for users that enabled DeserializationFeature.UNWRAP_SINGLE_VALUE_ARRAYS.

affected_components.role: The unwrap branch detects a second START_ARRAY before its recursive deserialize call.
Regression oracle builds deeply nested array wrappers and requires mapping-error rejection.

negative_controls: A mapper without UNWRAP_SINGLE_VALUE_ARRAYS is outside the audit-stated exposure condition.
No execution result for either vulnerable or fixed revision is present in this bundle.
observability.positive_marker: Post-fix contract is MismatchedInputException with diagnostics including nested JSON Array and only single.

preconditions: The target application deserializes attacker-controlled JSON into a bean/object.

trigger_steps.payload_shape: 9,999 opening array delimiters, an object value, and 9,999 closing delimiters.
trigger_steps.summary: Submit a JSON object value enclosed by a very large number of nested array wrappers to the configured mapper.

relation_candidates.rationale: The supplied nested-array document is consumed under the enabled unwrapping feature, and the implementation's unwrap path recursively calls deserialize.
relation_candidates.src: attacker-controlled deeply nested JSON array wrappers

relation_candidates.rationale: The audit reports BeanDeserializer stack exhaustion, while the post-fix source introduces a check specifically to prevent unbounded nested arrays before the recursive call.
The audit states that stack exhaustion can crash jackson-databind and the running application.
The patch rejects a second START_ARRAY before deserialize and documents that only one wrapper is allowed.

sources.concept: attacker-controlled deeply nested JSON array wrappers

impact.affected_asset: Availability of jackson-databind and the application hosting it.
impact.attacker_capability: Cause a feature-enabled application to process deeply nested JSON array wrappers around a bean value.
impact.security_effect: Denial of service through stack exhaustion and application crash.

causal_trace.summary: An attacker-controlled JSON value can be constructed with 9,999 nested array wrappers around an object while the single-value-array unwrapping feature is enabled.
The unwrapping feature must permit only a single wrapper array; before the added check, a further START_ARRAY was not rejected before recursive processing.
After unwrapping, BeanDeserializer invokes deserialize recursively; arbitrarily nested array layers therefore drive unbounded recursive deserialization.
The audit reports stack overflow/exhaustion in BeanDeserializer that can crash jackson-databind and the hosting application.

failure.operation: Recursive BeanDeserializer deserialization while unwrapping deeply nested JSON arrays, leading to Java stack exhaustion.

primary_invariant.statement: UNWRAP_SINGLE_VALUE_ARRAYS permits one wrapper array only.
primary_invariant.violated_because: A second START_ARRAY was allowed to proceed to recursive deserialization rather than being rejected.

quality.review_notes: The regression test is an oracle contract, not evidence of a test run. The audit identifies ADA-Jackson-9 and this BeanDeserializer fix as CVE-2022-42003, whereas the supplied maintainer issue/OSV material associates issue #3582 and the same commit with CVE-2022-42004. This record retains the audit finding identity and does not assert a reconciled CVE-to-finding mapping. Historical pre-fix source and an OSS-Fuzz crash artifact are absent.

remediation.invariant_restored: On the unwrap path, BeanDeserializer detects a further START_ARRAY and raises an unexpected-token mapping error; it does not recursively unwrap multiple array layers.
mitigation_classes: reject nested array token before recursive deserialization

state_context.attacker_state_setup: The application must enable DeserializationFeature.UNWRAP_SINGLE_VALUE_ARRAYS and pass a JSON document with many array wrappers around an object.
data_structure_invariants: Only one JSON array wrapper may be unwrapped for a scalar/object target value.

numeric_domains.attacker_constraints: The supplied regression constructor uses 9,999 wrappers; its comment says the pre-fix behavior failed at 5,000.
numeric_domains.name: array-wrapper nesting

state_context.state_machine: When array unwrapping is enabled, the fixed implementation permits one wrapper, rejects a second START_ARRAY, and otherwise deserializes the wrapped value before requiring END_ARRAY.

affected_versions_or_commits.value: versions fixed in 2.13.4; audit does not establish a complete affected-version range

oracle.expected_negative: The input must not successfully deserialize; the test's stated contract is rejection rather than recursive processing.
oracle.expected_positive: A 9,999-wrapper JSON document supplied to an ObjectMapper with UNWRAP_SINGLE_VALUE_ARRAYS enabled is rejected with MismatchedInputException containing the nested-array and single-wrapper diagnostics.
